item.title: Quail: High-Throughput AI-SQL Engine Co-Optimizing Query Plans and LLMs
item.description: Quail jointly optimizes SQL execution plans and LLM KV cache reuse, beating vLLM on 27 of 29 AI-SQL benchmark queries with a 1.84x geometric mean speedup.

item.title: Gemini-SQL2 Crosses 80% Execution Accuracy on the BIRD Benchmark
item.description: Google’s specialized Gemini-SQL2 model hits 80.04% execution accuracy on BIRD, highlighting domain fine-tuning gains and cloud data platform integration.
